labelling_rules: Label the customer's LATEST message; use earlier thread turns only to understand it.
If the latest message only supplies information the brand asked for (device, app version, 'yes it still happens'), label the topic of the thread.
If two intents apply, pick the one the customer most needs resolved.
Escalate = a human should review before anything is posted publicly. A reply that simply asks the customer to DM is fine to auto-send for routine issues.

intents.name: Playback / app problem
intents.definition: Something in the app or player is not working: songs won't play, skip, stop or are greyed out; crashes, freezes, app errors; downloads disappearing; device or integration problems (PS4, Roku, Alexa, car, Apple Watch).
includes: ads or ad-free time behaving wrongly

intents.name: Login / account details
intents.definition: Getting into or managing the account: can't log in, forgot password or email, Facebook login or unlinking, duplicate accounts, changing email/username/country, closing an account.
includes: account shows the wrong country or language
excludes: signs someone else took over the account (account_security)

intents.name: Hacked / compromised account
intents.definition: Signs that someone else accessed or controls the account: unknown playlists or listening activity, email or password changed without the customer, 'my account was hacked/stolen'.
includes: email-change notification the customer didn't request

intents.name: Billing / plans
intents.definition: Money and subscriptions: charges, double charges, refunds, paid but not Premium, cancelling or renewing, payment method errors, trials and offers, Family, Student and Hulu bundle plans.

intents.name: Music / podcast catalogue
intents.definition: What is or isn't on Spotify: when an album or song will be available, content removed or greyed out for licensing, wrong song or artist metadata, artist profile mix-ups, podcast availability.
includes: two artists merged into one profile
excludes: a song that exists but won't play because of a bug (playback_technical)

intents.name: Feature request / product feedback
intents.definition: Suggestions, wishes and opinions about the product rather than a malfunction: new features, design changes, recommendation or playlist quality, complaints about free-tier limits, requests to launch in a country.
excludes: something that used to work is now broken (playback_technical)

intents.name: Following up on a DM / case
intents.definition: The customer points to an existing private conversation or case: 'check your DMs', 'I emailed you', 'still waiting for a reply'.
excludes: a new problem described in full (label that problem)

intents.name: Thanks / resolved / praise
intents.definition: No open request: thanks, confirmation that a fix worked, or compliments.
excludes: thanks followed by a new question (label the question)

intents.name: Other
intents.definition: None of the above: off-topic chatter, jokes, job or partnership requests, unintelligible messages, support requests in another language.

escalation_reasons.definition: Possible account takeover or unauthorised access.
Money taken unexpectedly or wrongly: double charges, charged after cancelling, paid but not upgraded, refund demands.
Legal threats, consumer-rights or regulator mentions, data deletion/GDPR requests, or the customer has posted sensitive personal data (email, card, receipt) publicly.
Self-harm, threats, harassment, or anyone at risk.
Repeated failed contacts or long waits, very angry or abusive tone, cancellation threats, or a complaint likely to escalate publicly if answered with a template.
No safe, useful public reply is possible without a human looking into it (for example several issues at once, or any template reply would be wrong or insulting).
